episodes.summary: Reopen the Beryl service card because the replacement spring stops at a different point. The Beryl service card must add the winding-stop instruction. For Beryl, you can share the register only after Kira accepts the service card. For Beryl, permission to share the register also requires that the bench log records a full winding cycle. Both conditions for permission to share the register in Beryl are necessary because a partial cycle misses the stop point. For the next step on Beryl clock register, keep replacement springs at the bench. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.
